checks.row_formula: 4 controls + 36 sources + 8 measurement examples + (4 gate prefixes * 73 rules * 36 sources = 10512 matrix examples) + 36 special controls = 10596

accuracy_notes: The London Plan 2021 was retained as current adopted policy while the July 2026 Draft London Plan was kept as consultation evidence only.
PTAL and TIM were treated as accessibility/connectivity tools rather than permission, legal access, guaranteed journey time or spare transport capacity.
Strategic 2041 mode-share and additional-trip figures were not downscaled into parcel travel behaviour or trip generation.
TfL Transport Assessment requirements were not converted into approval/refusal outcomes.
Cycling, EV and transport-infrastructure programme totals were not treated as site-specific availability or delivered mitigation.
No parcel relation, Future Growth score, business row, transport mitigation cost or planning outcome was fabricated.
